tool_map.name: Explore Shapes Around Us
tool_map.objective: Students group everyday objects that look alike and notice which ones roll, slide or stand.
tool_map.purpose: Explore a ball, dice, bottle, shoebox and birthday cap. Rotate and observe, match similar objects and notice which can roll, slide or stand.

tool_map.name: Meet the 3D Shapes
tool_map.objective: Students name the five solids, even when turned, and match each to an everyday object.
tool_map.purpose: Rotate each solid, observe it from different sides, recognise/name it and match it with familiar objects.

tool_map.name: Explore Faces, Edges and Corners
tool_map.objective: Students find the faces, edges and corners of solids and use flat and curved parts to tell solids apart.
tool_map.purpose: Select a face, trace an edge, identify a corner and compare features across solids.

tool_map.name: Identify Shapes in Constructions
tool_map.objective: Students name and count the solids in a construction and say where one is using on top, under or between.
tool_map.purpose: Select parts, identify the solid shape, count shapes and use position words such as on top, under and between.

tool_map.name: Build and Describe
tool_map.objective: Students arrange solid shapes into a model and describe where each shape is so others can build it.
tool_map.purpose: Arrange shapes to create a model; describe where each shape is placed; recreate a model from a simple description.

tool_map.approved_name: Build with Clay, Sticks and Cubes
tool_map.name: Build with Clay, Sticks and Cubes
tool_map.objective: Students make solid shapes from clay balls and sticks and from cubes, and count the cubes used.
tool_map.purpose: Join clay balls and sticks, explore what they represent, combine cubes and count visible/hidden cubes where relevant.

tool_map.name: Compare and Discover
tool_map.objective: Students compare solids and say in what ways they are the same and in what ways they are different.
tool_map.purpose: Compare solids, identify shared/different properties and explain observations using simple prompts.

tool_map.name: Shape Challenges and Games
tool_map.objective: Students recognise solid shapes, even when turned, and read the opposite faces of a die.
tool_map.purpose: Apply learning through shape identification, dice patterns, opposite-face predictions and different-view challenges.
